title: PR #113: docs(audit): add exact-SHA source inventory baseline
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Purpose

Adds an exact-head/tree census for all 33 organization repositories as a prerequisite for completing the component/function list.

## Evidence

- 33 repositories recorded: 26 active, 7 archived.
- Records default branch, observed head SHA, Git tree SHA, tracked blob count and filtered source-file count.
- Source tree baseline: 8,177 candidate source files under the documented extension/path filter; this is a file count, **not** a function count.
- Function symbol scan is explicitly `PENDING`; all function inventories remain `RESIDUAL`. No claim of catalog completeness or production readiness is made.

## Next work

Implement language-aware symbol extraction, map each public/exported function/API/syscall/RPC/CLI/event entrypoint to a component/function contract or reasoned exclusion, and bind results to exact source SHA. No merge, no gate relaxation, no repository lifecycle changes.
